title: Newton iteration counts for self-concordant functions
input_provenance: Random instances use NumPy PCG64, with saved arrays and seeds. They are method reproductions; MATLAB rand(state,...) uses v5uniform and randn(state,...) uses v5normal, whereas seed selects the v4 family. Equal integer seeds do not identify equal arrays. No exact MATLAB fixture was published in the checked companion sources; exact book-figure matching is not claimed.
notes: The source uses MATLAB v4 seed semantics, unlike the state-based figures elsewhere. New PCG64 arrays are saved explicitly. The center rejection threshold is squared decrement 1e-12 after at most 20 steps; the source uses decrement 1e-8. The replacement right-hand sides use uniform (0.001,1). Rejection is recorded, rather than conflating nonconvergence in 20 steps with a mathematical proof of unboundedness.
